G=load()
def props(n):
    i=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=i.shape
    res=[]
    for r,c in zip(*np.where(i!=o)):
        v=int(i[r,c]); t=int(o[r,c])
        # same-color neighborhood within 8? any same-color neighbor incl diagonal?
        nb=[int(i[rr,cc]) for rr in range(max(0,r-1),min(H,r+2)) for cc in range(max(0,c-1),min(W,c+2)) if (rr,cc)!=(r,c)]
        has=sum(1 for x in nb if x==v)
        cnt=Counter(nb)
        info={'r':int(r),'c':int(c),'v':v,'to':t,'nb_same':has,'top_nb':cnt.most_common()}
        res.append(info)
    return res
for n in range(1,9):
    print('pair',n,len(props(n)))
    rs=props(n)
    print([(x['v'],x['to'],x['nb_same']) for x in rs][:20])

import numpy as np, os,glob,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    G={}
    for p in glob.glob(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
        t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

import numpy as np, os,glob,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
base=d+'/../../sessions'
G={}
for fn in glob.glob(base+'/*.jsonl')+glob.glob(base+'/*/*.jsonl'):
    t=open(fn).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    bkg=int(np.bincount(g.ravel().tolist()).argmax())
    res=g.copy()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=int(g[i,j])
            if c==bkg: continue
            L=R=j-1;j2=j+1
            while L>=0 and g[i,L]==c: L-=1
            while j2<W and g[i,j2]==c: j2+=1
            hlen=j2-L-1
            U=D=i-1;i2=i+1
            vj=g[:,j]
            while U>=0 and vj[U]==c: U-=1
            while i2<H and vj[i2]==c: i2+=1
            vlen=i2-U-1
            if hlen==1 and vlen==1:  # isolated singleton
                nb=[]
                for di,dj in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                    ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
                    if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and g[ni,nj]!=bkg: nb.append(int(g[ni,nj]))
                if nb:
                    res[i,j]=max(set(nb),key=nb.count)
    return res.tolist()
ok=True
for k in range(1,9):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    m=f(inp)==out
    ok&=m; print(k,'match' if m else 'FAIL')
res=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(res))

import numpy as np, os,re,glob,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']); base=d+'/../../sessions'

    t=open(fn).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def analyze(k):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); go=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
    H,W=gi.shape
    cnt=Counter(gi.ravel()); bkg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    info=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i,j]==go[i,j]: continue
            c=int(gi[i,j]); o=int(go[i,j])
            nb=Counter(int(gi[ni,nj]) for ni,nj in [(i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)] if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W)
            top=nb.most_common()
            info.append(dict(c=c,o=o,bg=bkg,nb=dict(top)))
    return gi,bkg,info
gi,bkg,info=analyze(1)
print('pair 1 bg',bkg)
for x in info: print(x)

            res[i,j]=max(top)  # try max first
    return res

def noise_cells(g):
    # cells without any orthogonal same-color neighbor
    return [(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if not any(0<=i+di<len(g) and 0<=j+dj<len(g[0]) and g[i+di][j+dj]==g[i][j] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))]
def fill_mode(g, mode='majority'):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,j,c in noise_cells(g):
        nb8=[out[k][l] for k,l in ((i-1,j-1),(i-1,j),(i-1,j+1),(i,j-1),(i,j+1),(i+1,j-1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)) if 0<=k<H and 0<=l<W]
        if mode=='majority':
            cnt=Counter(nb8); col,_=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        elif mode=='orthonly':
            nb4=[o for o in nb8 if True] 
            nb4_=[out[i+k][j+l] for k,l in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)) if 0<=i+k<H and 0<=j+l<W]
            cnt=Counter(nb4_); col,_=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        out[i][j]=col
    return out
for kp in ['Demo pair %d'%(k) for k in (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8)]:
    gi=load()[kp+' input']; go=load()[kp+' output']
    ok8=sum(o[i][j]==g[i][j] for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0]))) / len(gi)**2
    cand = fill_mode(gi,'majority'); orth = fill_mode(gi,'orth')
    d=cand==go; or_=orth==go
    print(kp.replace('input',''),'maj8',d,'| orth4',or_)
